snippet.title: Fortune Fragments Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game!  
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4150850/Fortune_Fragments/  

Follow the Adventures of Runoi!
Social Media Links & Contact Info: https://runoigames.com/ 

Fortune telling puzzle-RPG Fortune Fragments is launching on Steam June 24th, 2026!

Runoi Games is a curious party of gaming sorcerers emerging from the depths of the northern woodlands. Follow our adventure into unseen dimensions, moulding unconventional ideas to create role-playing magic, challenging the bounds of storytelling and game play!
